title: Improving the diagnosis of periodontitis using machine learning algorithms and integrated diagnostics: a retrospective study
summary: Periodontitis is an inflammation of the tissues supporting the teeth. This study investigates whether computer programs using artificial intelligence can help to detect periodontitis on panoramic radiographs and to classify its severity. It also examines whether findings that are otherwise measured on the patient, such as the depth of gum pockets, tooth mobility and involvement of the root furcation, can be inferred from the radiograph. Only existing data from patients recorded at the department between 2011 and 2017 will be analysed. The data are fully anonymised. The results may help to diagnose periodontitis more accurately, more quickly and more effectively.

interventions.name: Arm 1: Retrospective analysis of all patients aged 18 years or older with diagnosed periodontitis and complete radiographic and clinical periodontal findings recorded between 2011 and 2017 at the Department of Conservative Dentistry and Periodontology.
